channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "The Seed of an Idea"

item.title: Update
item.content:encoded: I've made a bit of an expansion to the dialogue here in response to critique. Something I've wanted to do for a little while. Feedback on that — and further critique — welcome.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I can't take Gloves seriously as a high-ranking Foundation official when their response to hearing what they think is a disastrously awful idea is 'well, it's terrible, but at least it'll be entertaining', which leaves me wondering how exactly the Foundation doesn't lose sites on a more regular basis.

Understandable. This is deliberately more in line with stories like The Flytrap; I would argue that both portrayals are realistic, since you don't have to look far at all to hear some real-life very powerful people saying a bunch of shit far worse than this. However… if it breaks your suspension of disbelief, if breaks your suspension of disbelief. No worries.

(one of them literally says 'If it crashes and burns, so be it' as if that's not a terrible, terrible problem).

In fairness, they more mean "politically disastrous" than actual crashing and burning and losing sites and lives. Thoughts on making that more clear?

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Agreed on most of these points (I hadn't considered nudity, but this is now my headcanon). Only about half of this actually seems like an in-story introduction, with the rest being meta discussion about how people will react to it. I never thought I would say this, but I wish that this was more meta, at least in the sense that I wish that there was some meta-explanation of why this should be a thing again. Instead, what we have is a weird combination of in-story explanation for why Alpha-9 should be a thing and out-of-story asides that basically amount to "wow this might not go well and people might hate it, huh?"

Nonetheless, I thought that the writing was solid enough to merit an upvote, so there's that.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: There's a lot I don't like here. I'm not really convinced that any of the points made by those in favour of Alpha-9 make sense here (one of them literally says 'If it crashes and burns, so be it' as if that's not a terrible, terrible problem). I can't take Gloves seriously as a high-ranking Foundation official when their response to hearing what they think is a disastrously awful idea is 'well, it's terrible, but at least it'll be entertaining', which leaves me wondering how exactly the Foundation doesn't lose sites on a more regular basis. The character introduction is sketchy (it leaves me imagining that everyone except suit is naked). And the last lines are just far too cheesy for me to take this seriously.

I read these out of order. Still loved every one of them. +1

We (both as Authors and the IC Foundation) opened the box, and let bad things into the world. We slammed the box shut and refused to look back into it. Now we're peeking back inside and finding the hope that was left.

Eagerly awaiting the Canon hub and the tales to follow.
